integrity_notes: The proof derives the infinite statements analytically; numerical checks are supplementary. No independent audit or validation has been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Driftless equicorrelated Brownian searchers with identical starting positions and fixed diffusivity. The criterion for finite means applies to the limiting arrival-time law and does not infer finite-N expectation convergence. Broader correlated-diffusion coverage remains a literature risk.
title: A common-noise crossover and sharp limiting mean threshold for fastest Brownian first passage
